{{short description|Describes the behavior in Zp extensions of the Selmer group of an abelian variety}}
In [[number theory]], '''Mazur's control theorem''', introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Mazur|authorlink=Barry Mazur|year=1972}},  describes the behavior in '''Z'''<sub>''p''</sub> extensions of the [[Selmer group]] of an [[abelian variety]] over a [[number field]].
